caption: The drawing depicts a carved architectural element, possibly a corbel or capital, with a stylized face or mask motif. The object is rendered in shades of gray, black, and light blue, primarily using pencil or graphite with some blue shading for depth and emphasis. The structure has a rectangular, horizontal top surface with parallel lines indicating its layered or stepped design. Beneath the top, the carved face consists of bold, curved outlines forming prominent features such as two circular or oval eye-like shapes, a central dot or indentation above the eyes, an abstract nose, and a rectangular mouth with a series of pointed, triangular teeth along the bottom edge. The left side of the object is partially obscured by shading and appears to be set against or attached to a vertical surface, indicated by straight and angled lines. The background is mostly unadorned, with some light sketch marks and minimal shading, focusing the viewer's attention on the carved object. The overall composition is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding the primary subject.
title: Architectural Detail
